name: Geʽez (Classical Ethiopic)
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Geʽez is Classical Ethiopic, the liturgical South-Semitic language of Ethiopia and the literary ancestor and prestige source of the modern Ethiopian Semitic languages Amharic and Tigrinya. It exists so that those specs have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. A table needs a cited description of the Ethiopic (fidel) syllabary as used for Geʽez and the sound value of each syllable sign.
